name: dlss5-swapper
description: Install, tune and restore DLSS 5 in your games with one click. Native RenoDX, DLSS5-Feeder for games without DLSS, OptiScaler and multipass routes; DirectX 8/9/11/12, Vulkan, OpenGL, DirectDraw and emulators. In-game F8 overlay, automatic backups, and a community page showing what works on your games and your graphics card.
